source_roots.results: provided explicitly to the builder at run time
source_roots.source: the public source repository supplied to the builder

path_contract.source_path_rule: Every source_prefix and source anchor is relative to results_root and uses forward slashes.
path_contract.destination_path_rule: Every destination_prefix is relative to the movable core-results directory.

copy_policy.source_hash_policy: Verify the source anchor before copying; record the source and released SHA-256 separately whenever relocation changes bytes.
copy_policy.large_file_policy: Reject any unlisted file and any checkpoint, optimizer state, raw W&B export, cache, log, or source snapshot unless explicitly whitelisted here.
